occupied(R) :- queen(R,C), row(R), column(C).
:- not occupied(R), row(R).
:- row(R), column(C1), column(C2), C1!=C2, queen(R,C1), queen(R,C2).
:- column(C), row(R1), row(R2), R1!=R2, queen(R1,C), queen(R2,C).
:- row(R1), row(R2), column(C1), column(C2), R1!=R2, queen(R1,C1), queen(R2,C2), R1-R2 = C1-C2.
:- row(R1), row(R2), column(C1), column(C2), R1!=R2, queen(R1,C1), queen(R2,C2), R1-R2 = C2-C1.
